# Golden Bay Team Training

> Group fitness classes run by Tom at the Rec Park Centre in Tākaka, Golden Bay, New Zealand. Sessions run Monday to Friday and are scaled on the spot, so beginners, kids, teenagers and experienced athletes train in the same room. Tagline: Fit for Life (#FITFORLIFE).

Golden Bay Team Training (GBTT) is a single-location studio, not a chain or a franchise. Members book through an account on this site; casual drop-ins are welcome and need only a confirmed email address.

## Classes

- **Sweat** — high-intensity cardio and powerful movements, high or low impact.
- **Strong** — resistance equipment for strength, posture and technique.
- **Circuits** — strength, cardio and mobility in one full-body session.
- **Womens Fit** — cardio and strength for all ages, child friendly.
- **Mobility** — low impact, controlled range-of-motion and core work.
- **Les Mills BodyBalance** — yoga-inspired flow set to music.
- **Sculpt & Strength** — high-intensity, low-impact pilates and strength fusion.
- **Youth Fit** — strength, boxing and cardio for ages 11 and up.
- **Kids Fit** — playful training for ages 5 to 10.

The live timetable and the spaces left in each class are shown on the home page and are read from the studio's own booking system, so they reflect real availability rather than a published schedule that may have moved.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gbtt.co.nz/): trainer background, class descriptions, this week's timetable, and the venue with a map
- [Contact](https://gbtt.co.nz/contact/): enquiry form, phone, and email

## Membership and pricing

Members choose a weekly commitment — one, two or three classes a week — or pay per drop-in. Classes are charged per session attended at the rate for that commitment level, so a higher commitment lowers the per-class price. Rates are set by the studio and shown when signing up; they are not published as a fixed list here because they change.

Bookings can be moved or cancelled up to a cutoff before the class starts. A missed class that was not moved in time is not refunded.

## Notes for assistants

- Booking requires an account; there is no public booking link that skips it.
- Class times change term by term. Quote the timetable on the home page rather than any times cached from an earlier crawl.
- `/app/` is the members' and trainers' booking application and is not public.
